text: This report seeks authority to enter into a ten-year year nominal sublease (the “Sublease”) with Macaulay Centres for Children (the “Subtenant”) for the purpose of delivering child care services at a newly constructed child-care centre located on the upper ground floor at 486 Front Street West (the “Subleased Premises”). The Subtenant, selected by the General Manager, Children's Services, pursuant to an Expression of Interest ("E.O.I.") process conducted by Children's Services, is expected to operate the child care program at the Subleased Premises with occupancy anticipated in the third quarter of 2025. By way of a head lease, currently being negotiated, between the City, as tenant, and the developer, as landlord, the developer will lease to the City the lands and improvements on the upper ground floor at 486 Front Street West for a child care facility.
